login.title: Sign in to Stroppy Cloud
login.devBody: This stand runs without Kratos: enter one of the static tokens configured on the server (STROPPY_DEV_USERS).

register.title: Create an account
register.name: Display name
register.verifyBody: Tenant invites and the e-mail in your profile apply once the address is confirmed — check the inbox (Mailpit at :8025 on the local stand).
register.closedBody: This installation does not accept self sign-up. Ask the platform administrator for an account.
